newsitem.title: THAILAND: Krung Thai Bank says cuts lending rate.
newsitem.headline: Krung Thai Bank says cuts lending rate.

text.p: BANGKOK, Oct 8 (Reuer) - Thailand's Krung Thai Bank Plc said it would cut its minimum retail rate (MRR) by 25 basis points to 13.25 percent, effective Wednesday.
The reduction of MRR is in line with the market situation and the bank's cost of funds, Krung Thai Bank said in a statement on Tuesday.
Its other lending rates -- the minimum overdraft rate (MOR) and minimum lending rate (MLR) -- remain unchanged at 13.25 percent per year, the bank said.
The MRR is the rate charged on loans to retail borrowers and on loans to credit card customer.
